contentGaps: Keep the original bulbs in a labeled bag and restore them on move-out so the unit is returned as found
Wall-switch problem in shared or landlord-controlled fixtures: tape or a switch guard so roommates do not cut power; no-wiring alternatives
Enclosed or ceiling fixtures: check the bulb's enclosed-fixture rating and heat; smart bulbs in tight domes can fail early
Lamps first: moving smart bulbs between lamps you own is the lowest-risk renter setup
Choosing a system that travels: hubless Wi-Fi/Matter bulbs pack easily vs a Bridge that needs ethernet at the router
Shared apartment Wi-Fi: 2.4 GHz-only bulbs, captive portals and router access in managed buildings
Do not rewire or replace the switch: landlord approval issue, so choose bulbs, not smart switches
Distinct angle from the Hue vs WiZ comparison: a 7-pick roundup by renter use case (lamp, ceiling fixture, budget, color, Matter) rather than a two-brand head-to-head
